I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April renewal date she overheard for Brackenwater Freight Co.

I only checked what Pree can see herself: #central-team (she's a member) and the shared files. Neither has a contract, CRM entry or profile for Brackenwater, and no one has posted a renewal date for them in #central-team. I said all this in the thread, noted the date as unverified and didn't record it anywhere. I suggested she ask the account owner to check it against the signed contract or get it in writing from Brackenwater.

A renewal date is an operational fact rather than a money term, so no approval was needed to discuss it in a team channel.
